title: EODC Federation Extension
description: Provider-federation and metadata-harmonization provenance fields added by the EODC federated STAC catalogue (catalogue.services.eodc.eu). Reference this schema from an object's `stac_extensions`.

anyOf.$comment: Collection: extension fields live in `summaries`; provenance at the top level.

federation:backends.title: Federated providers
federation:backends.description: Names of the EODAG providers that can serve this object (federation is search-time; collections are not merged).

^federation:source_.title: Pre-harmonization source value
^federation:source_.description: Original value(s) before vocabulary normalization, kept for backtracking.

provenance.title: Harmonization provenance
provenance.description: 1:1 backtracking record: where the object came from and what the harmonization layer changed.

profile_version.description: Version of the harmonization rules that produced the object.

target_stac_version.description: STAC version the object was migrated to.

source.title: Source
source.description: The single source this object corresponds to (federation never merges).

kind.description: 'upstream-collection': pass-through with a known source document URL. 'provider-product': locally federated collection, identified by provider(s).

href.description: Source collection URL, when one exists (upstream-collection).

transformations.description: Field-level operations applied by the harmonization layer.
